correctness.rationale: The frozen Step 4 has a false factorwise identity for nonreal roots: for q=2, alpha=-1+i sqrt(2) and w=i/2 even give the opposite sign on its left-hand side. The complete corrected RESULT.md at /workspace/repairs/4/RESULT.md pairs each factor w-alpha with 1-conjugate(alpha)*w, using the real monic A to justify the reindexing. The identity is then exact and strict in the open disk. Enestrom–Kakeya places every root of A outside the closed disk, and coefficient reciprocity rules out outside roots of P; q=0, including n=0, is immediate. Independently checked the unchanged bound: Fejer–Riesz and normalization give exactly the triangular Gram form; shifted indicator polynomials are independent, so it is positive definite. Its second-difference kernel reduces Bu to a constant since each supported step-m ladder is affine at interior indices, including the adjoining zero at the missing end when r>0; for r=0 the coinciding ladders give constant values on the single residue class. Ordinary symmetry and evaluation at index 0 give Bu=1, also for the empty interior case. Summing u, then applying the positive-definite Cauchy–Schwarz identity, gives the exact coefficient and full equality class, for complex factors and after shifting a prescribed point. The theorem, normalization, all boundary cases and equality claims are unchanged. The frozen rational script only checks the finite matrix identities and is recorded corroboration, not a proof of the root claim or the all-index theorem.
